author_declaration.freshness_basis: Independently devised goals and constraints from the seven public scope categories after receiving only the runtime digest. No comparison with prior private cases was performed because that would breach blindness.
author_declaration.additional_reads: Current working directory, git status path list, and existence checks of the two owned paths only.
author_declaration.scope_document_exposure: The permitted Level 0 scope includes public development examples and historical milestone summaries; no linked artifact contents were opened.
author_declaration.shared_edit_boundary: Only the two v7 artifacts were created. No shared docs, source, index, or prior artifacts edited.

validation.variation_call_budget_path: pass: initial + three base answers + optional closeout + variation + one variation answer <= seven; no guaranteed answer completion
validation.question_budget_path: pass: three base questions plus one variation follow-up <= five; bundled information requests count separately

limits_per_case_per_approach.diagnostic_reruns: Outside acceptance only; separately labelled and never substituted for a first attempt.

limitations: Structural validation and author self-review only; acceptance execution, independent outcome adjudication, and adult comprehension remain unperformed.
All hidden operator facts are conditional on actual disclosure. Inferable consequences may be met by a question or explicit open decision rather than a guessed value.
Budgets may leave a base or variation incomplete; retain not-checked phases rather than adding calls, questions, retries, or hidden answers.
The author cannot certify distinctness from unseen prior private suites. The cases are not mere rewordings of the permitted public examples.
The deterministic service-failure specification is separate from native seven-case acceptance and provides no live reliability evidence.
